found.en: Perhaps the best challenge to the idea that British food is bland is found in “curry”.
found.zh: 对英国食物平淡无奇这一观点的最好挑战也许可以在“咖喱”中找到。

found.en: The foods might have South Asian roots and inspiration, but they are uniquely found in Britain.
found.zh: 这些食物可能有南亚的根源和灵感，但它们是英国独有的。

found.en: And what we found in this study was, yes, these scratching videos indeed made people feel itchier.
found.zh: And what we found in this study was, yes, these scratching videos indeed made people feel itchier.

found.en: Yes, and Hannah found that most strangers she spoke to were friendly and happy to help, so she didn't really experience rejection much at all.
found.zh: 是的，Hannah 发现与她交谈的大多数陌生人都很友善且乐于助人，所以她实际上并没有经历多少次拒绝。

found.en: For decades, nuclear power depended almost entirely on governments: government funding, government regulation, government risk-taking, because private investors found it too expensive and too slow.
found.zh: 几十年来，核电几乎完全依赖政府：政府出资、政府监管、政府承担风险，因为私人投资者觉得它太昂贵、见效太慢。

forum.en: Let me know in the comments below, if you're listening to this somewhere where you can comment, and for the members among you, you can head right into our community forum, which is at community.leonardoenglish.com and get chatting away to other curious minds.
forum.zh: 如果你收听节目的地方可以评论，欢迎在下方留言；对于会员朋友，你们可以直接前往我们的社区论坛 community.leonardoenglish.com，与其他求知欲强烈的听友交流畅聊。
